identity: The Charter of Stone's gather quests by depth tier, given at every own mining camp whose lift reaches the tier (Round 58); no map zone.

variants.text: [PH] The Charter of Stone needs Iron Lump × 20 from the second depth. Take the camp's lift down to the tier's rooms and dig. Real text to follow.
